crossRefs.note: I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.
I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;
My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They will know that I, Yahweh, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are My people,’ declares the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: And they shall know that I, Jehovah, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord Jehovah.
